issues.detail: The Hebrew 'צַמְתֶּם וְסָפוֹד' means 'you fasted and mourned' (fasting + mourning), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'ăn ở than khóc' (lived and wept), dropping the concept of fasting entirely and adding 'ăn ở' (lived) which is not in the Hebrew. This changes the meaning of the verse.
